# Cecilion Mana Curve Draft

A greedier curve only survives if it does not surrender early river authorship.

## What to watch

- Check the first three rotation contests closely.
- Separate theoretical scaling from actual lane loss.
- Reject any route that makes him dead weight early.

## Draft focus

Scaling is only premium when the road to it keeps the map intact.

> The curve matters only if the map can survive the wait.

More on Cecilion: keep this read connected to mage mid structures, not just isolated mechanics.
